query: INSERT INTO social_media_category_settings (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, category_key, auto_post, updated_by) SELECT s.twitch_login, s.twitch_user_id, k.category_key, (k.category_key = $2), 'auto_default' FROM social_media_category k CROSS JOIN twitch_streamers s WHERE s.twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id, category_key) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
